author: Polar_Express
body:
I know a lot of us have submitted maps, and some have been accepted, but what does accepted mean? And can we get an update of the maps, status, when they plan on being placed into rotation, and anything that may need to be changed or corrected? It would be great to also get a Reject list so that the map makers can focus on what they need to do.

Thanks! -

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Accepted doesn't mean it will instantly get added into rotations.
If a map is Accepted, it means it will be put under further testing (Making sure the YML works properly is an important part of it as well).
I do usually keep map makers updated on their maps, if I've missed out some you can always contact me via skype, I'll be more than glad to help.

If you're asking this because of your map, Dark Wood, the save file seems to be corrupted. Could you provide me another download for it?
